name: Universal Brawl [GOKU]
desc:
***EXPECT BUGS***

 Welcome to OmniVerse Battlegrounds! 
Step into the arena, train hard, and battle others to claim the title of the Strongest Brawler! 

Play on Console or PC! 🎮📱💻

🖥️ Controls:
M1 - Attack
Q - Dash
F - Block
1, 2, 3, 4 - Activate Abilities
B - Emotes

👥 Join our Community Chat for codes, updates, and to connect with fellow brawlers! 🗨️
